name: Little Lemon Capstone Website
text:
I made this as the capstone project for the Meta Front-End Developer course on Coursera.  The project involved everything from early stage UI/UX design to coding.

In the first stage of this project, I was tasked with designing the wireframe and component in Figma (viewable with the links below).  This was done with the guidance of a provided style guide, which can be found in the link below.

The second stage involved creating the site layout in accordance with accessibility standards in addition to setting up OGP data and meta tags.

The third and most involved part of this project involved coding the site in react.  While not a fully functional site as the task only asked for a functional home and reservation pages, I nevertheless created those and added styling for a mobile view.  When running this project, when you click on the proper navbar option or reservation button, you are sent to the reservation page, where you must fill out the form to submit it.  Due to the API being nonfunctional when I was doing this project, the would-be output was instead simulated by taking the API functions and running the locally, returning a random set of available times depending on the selected date.  Once the form is completed, pressing the submit button simulates submitting it to a server and displays a confirmation for your reservation.
